info.name: Smartling REST API Reference Account & Projects API

params.name: accountUid
params.description: The account’s unique identifier. This can be found in the Smartling Dashboard under Account Settings > API.

params.name: projectNameFilter
params.description: Substring search of the name of the project. Search is case insensitive.

params.name: includeArchived
params.description: Indicator whether or not archived projects should be returned. Defaults to false if not specified.

params.name: offset
params.description: Standard Smartling limit and offset to paginate through results.

params.name: limit
params.description: Standard Smartling limit and offset to paginate through results. 500 projects are returned by default if not specified.

params.name: projectTypeCode
params.description: Indicator for the type of the project.

params.name: projectTypeCodes
params.description: Indicator list for the type of the projects.

items.docs: Returns the list of projects for the account.

params.name: projectId
params.description: A unique project identifier. This can be found in the Smartling Dashboard under Account Settings > API.

params.name: includeDisabledLocales
params.description: Indicator whether or not disabled locales configured for the project should be returned as part of the targetLocales. By default disabled target locales are not returned.

items.docs: Returns the details of a project.
